parameters.name: winrm_hook
parameters.description: predefined ssh_hook to use for remote execution

parameters.name: ssh_conn_id
parameters.description: connection id from airflow Connections

parameters.name: remote_host
parameters.description: remote host to connect

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: command to execute on remote host. (templated)

parameters.name: ps_path
parameters.description: path to powershell, `powershell` for v5.1- and `pwsh` for v6+. If specified, it will execute the command as powershell script.

parameters.name: output_encoding
parameters.description: the encoding used to decode stout and stderr

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: timeout for executing the command.

parameters.name: expected_return_code
parameters.description: expected return code value(s) of command.

parameters.name: working_directory
parameters.description: specify working directory.

parameters.name: ssh_conn_id
parameters.description: connection id from airflow Connections from where all the required parameters can be fetched like username and password, though priority is given to the params passed during init.

parameters.name: endpoint
parameters.description: When not set, endpoint will be constructed like this: 'http://{remote_host}:{remote_port}/wsman'

parameters.name: remote_host
parameters.description: Remote host to connect to. Ignored if `endpoint` is set.

parameters.name: remote_port
parameters.description: Remote port to connect to. Ignored if `endpoint` is set.

parameters.name: transport
parameters.description: transport type, one of 'plaintext' (default), 'kerberos', 'ssl', 'ntlm', 'credssp'

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: username to connect to the remote_host

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: password of the username to connect to the remote_host

parameters.name: service
parameters.description: the service name, default is HTTP

parameters.name: keytab
parameters.description: the path to a keytab file if you are using one

parameters.name: ca_trust_path
parameters.description: Certification Authority trust path

parameters.name: cert_pem
parameters.description: client authentication certificate file path in PEM format

parameters.name: cert_key_pem
parameters.description: client authentication certificate key file path in PEM format

parameters.name: server_cert_validation
parameters.description: whether server certificate should be validated on Python versions that support it; one of 'validate' (default), 'ignore'

parameters.name: kerberos_delegation
parameters.description: if True, TGT is sent to target server to allow multiple hops

parameters.name: read_timeout_sec
parameters.description: maximum seconds to wait before an HTTP connect/read times out (default 30). This value should be slightly higher than operation_timeout_sec, as the server can block *at least* that long.

parameters.name: operation_timeout_sec
parameters.description: maximum allowed time in seconds for any single wsman HTTP operation (default 20). Note that operation timeouts while receiving output (the only wsman operation that should take any significant time, and where these timeouts are expected) will be silently retried indefinitely.

parameters.name: kerberos_hostname_override
parameters.description: the hostname to use for the kerberos exchange (defaults to the hostname in the endpoint URL)

parameters.name: message_encryption
parameters.description: Will encrypt the WinRM messages if set and the transport auth supports message encryption. (Default 'auto')

parameters.name: credssp_disable_tlsv1_2
parameters.description: Whether to disable TLSv1.2 support and work with older protocols like TLSv1.0, default is False

parameters.name: send_cbt
parameters.description: Will send the channel bindings over a HTTPS channel (Default: True)
